meta_description: Find the annual rate of return on an account from its start and end values, dates and regular deposits or withdrawals, or project its ending value.
subtitle: Find the yearly rate of return on an account from its starting and ending values, the dates, and a regular schedule of deposits or withdrawals. You can also work the other way and project the ending value at a given rate.
